execution_policy.selection_rule: Execute exactly one eligible highest-priority READY atomic leaf, or one task explicitly marked acceptance_batch=true, per scheduled run; then STOP.
execution_policy.ssot_rule: Read current origin/main, LASTSTANDINGPOINT.md, this graph, relevant receipts, and all active engineering leases before selection.
execution_policy.lease_rule: Before any remote repository mutation, acquire both income-os.repo-write and factory-asset.<task_id> through bin/die_engineering_lease.py using the shared Architect MCP coordination root D:\mcp-architect\workspace\.engineering-leases; release both in finally. BUSY, corrupt, or token-mismatch states fail closed.
execution_policy.dirty_tree_rule: Do not mutate, reset, stash, clean, or repurpose the live dirty C:\DIE or D:\OAUTH trees.
execution_policy.linux_rule: Use a fresh Linux-native isolated worktree/check-out based on current origin/main for Linux-target implementation and tests; never build in or mutate the live /srv/die checkout.
execution_policy.production_protection_rule: The live Linux Production Organism and die-production-cycle-v1 at 0 */3 * * * are observation-only for this program: no deploy, restart, stop, reconfiguration, profile/credential/queue/database write, cron mutation, active-artifact mutation, or cutover.
execution_policy.windows_rule: D:\OAUTH provider work is Founder-directed and interactive on Windows; preserve the working text/chat-completion path, run before/after regression, and never let the autonomous Linux schedule select Windows tasks.
execution_policy.repair_rule: On failure create at most one minimal repair child <task_id>-R<n>; do not restart the roadmap unless an ADR assumption is falsified.

tasks.title: Execute one governed master and derivative family
tasks.acceptance: One provider master and all eligible deterministic derivatives are durable, idempotent and correctly counted as one semantic asset.

tasks.title: Complete governed canary registry and QA receipts
tasks.acceptance: Master, derivatives, package compatibility, duplicate suppression, QA and provider capacity evidence are committed through the canonical writer.

tasks.title: Integrate metadata and rights for canary package
tasks.acceptance: Metadata/keywords, AI disclosure, source rights and hard vetoes map to exact master/derivative hashes; uncertainty remains blocking.

tasks.title: Founder exact-hash QC for Factory Asset canary
tasks.acceptance: Founder records APPROVE|REJECT|REVISE against exact hashes; silence is not approval and no submission occurs.

tasks.title: Factory Asset Level Up v1 acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Blueprint, provider, immutable master, derivatives, registry, QA, metadata/rights, Founder QC and rollback evidence pass; publication remains outside scope.

LEVEL_1_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.definition: Real provider generation plus provider-original bytes durably saved and strictly validated on the Windows VPS. Operator-controlled generation/download is allowed and must be truthfully classified.
LEVEL_1_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY.does_not_prove: Zero-touch backend operation after job dispatch.

LEVEL_2_AUTONOMOUS_BACKEND_CANDIDACY.definition: A backend job/prompt is dispatched to an allowed provider transport and, with zero operator action after dispatch, completion is detected, provider-original bytes are acquired, strictly validated, content-addressed and durably saved locally with a typed receipt.
